section_summary.extract_value: This is the 'Limitations and Directions for Future Research' section of a single study examining body appreciation and related variables. The study involved first-year college women who were predominantly White and middle-class, with BMI assessed via self-reported height and weight. The authors acknowledge limitations including sample homogeneity, reliance on retrospective recall for caregiving messages, and the inability to establish causality from correlational data, while suggesting future research should employ longitudinal designs and include more diverse samples including men.
